user.title: Label Assistant
user.description: Design and print labels on your DYMO LabelWriter. Set the printer URL in the options after setup (defaults to the Label Printer add-on).

data_description.printer_url: HTTP address of the generic Label Printer add-on, e.g. http://local-label-printer:8000
data_description.default_printer: Queue name from the add-on (e.g. dymo or zebra). Leave empty to use the add-on's own default.
